assets.prompt: Sunken Reliquary: A reliquary chapel slid into a flooded quarry long ago. Through the green water you can see gilt glinting on the altar, and pale shapes drifting between the pews.
Market of Bones: Stalls of bleached bone and lacquered skulls under a canvas of stitched hides. The traders wear masks and accept any coin, any soul.
Ironwood Grove: Black-barked trees with leaves like beaten copper, ringing faintly in the wind. Their wood turns axes. The air in the grove is very still, and very watchful.
Cold Forge of the Deep: A deep-folk forge-hall cut into the hillside, its great furnace dead for an age. Half-finished constructs stand in rows, waiting for a fire that never came.
The Masked Envoy: A palanquin of black lacquer under a silk awning, guarded by slender figures in mirrored masks. A voice from behind the curtain offers to sell you the truth.
Frozen Warband: A whole raiding party frozen where it camped, rimed men still sitting round a dead fire. One of them blinks.
Shrine of the Low Tide: When the marsh draws back, a ring of carved stones rises from the mud, each one shaped like a coiled fish. Offerings of shell and bone lie on the central slab.
The Brand-Sergeant: A horned demon in a sergeant's sash sits on a crate of chains beside a glowing brazier. 'Recruiting,' it says, and grins with too many teeth.
Tomb of the Unbowed: A knight's tomb on a hill, the effigy's sword still clasped in stone hands. Fresh flowers lie at its feet, though there is no village for leagues.
The Giant's Toll: A cairn giant sits across the pass with a boulder in its lap, chewing on a tree. 'Toll,' it rumbles. 'Or song. Or fight. Giant is bored.'

Stargazer's Broken Tower: A tower snapped off halfway up, its top storey lying in the field like a fallen crown. Brass instruments still turn in the wind, tracking stars no one has seen since the sky went red.
The Plague Cart: A cart heaped with the shrouded dead, its driver slumped over the reins. A bell on the shaft still tolls with every gust of wind.

The Ember Crucible: A ring of slag around a pit of cinders that has not cooled in living memory. A blind tender rakes the coals and says the fire takes one soldier in and gives back what that soldier would have become after a lifetime of war.

Barrow of the Last Rank: A long mound where a whole regiment was buried standing, shields still locked. The shepherds say that whoever keeps the night watch here wakes up with the old regiment's discipline in their bones.
